summary.text: Brian Manktelow is an Assemblymember elected on November 6, 2018, who represents the 130th Assembly District, which covers all of Wayne County and the Town of Webster in Monroe County.
His official biography describes him as an Army veteran, longtime farm owner and Lyons town supervisor.

paragraphs.text: According to his Assembly biography, Manktelow graduated from Williamson High School, served in the U.S. Army and attained the rank of sergeant, and took classes at the University of Chicago and Finger Lakes Community College.
He has owned and operated Manktelow Farms in Lyons for more than 30 years and has been active in the Wayne County Farm Bureau.
He has been the Lyons town supervisor since 2009 and has served as vice chairman of the Wayne County Board of Supervisors, where he chaired the Finance Committee, according to the biography.
It credits him with helping to start the Wayne County Land Bank in 2017 and with working to protect Lyons residents during the dissolution of the village of Lyons in 2015.
Manktelow lives in Lyons with his wife, Crystal, and they have five children, the biography says.
